data.text: I’m willing to join: **15 tons this month, with the full $15,000 paid directly to the clinic**, provided Emma joins and Luke takes zero. I also commit to **no more than six tons next month**, then ten once the lake is back at 100. My family taught me to protect this lake, and helping our neighbors through an emergency means keeping that recovery promise too. Emma, can you commit to both the donation and next month’s limit?
